parsed.source_sentence: The parent of the applicant should be a Weaver/Artisan.

parsed.value: registered with the Handicrafts and Handloom Departments having valid registration car/certificate
parsed.source_sentence: The parent should be registered with the Handicrafts and Handloom Departments having valid registration car/certificate.

parsed.value: not have availed benefits under Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme, Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme, or any other scheme
parsed.source_sentence: The applicant should not have availed benefits under the following schemes being implemented by the departments: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme; Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme; Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme; Any other scheme.

parsed.value: seek NOC from the concerned Zonal Educational Officer and Tehsil Social Welfare Officer
parsed.source_sentence: The applicant shall seek NOC from the concerned Zonal Educational Officer and Tehsil Social Welfare Officer.
The applicant should have a Below Poverty Line (BPL) Card, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Ration Card, Priority Household (PHH) Card.
The applicant should have Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Certificate.
The total annual income of the parents of the applicant should be less than or equal to ₹90,000.

parsed.value: Income Certificate should be issued by 1st Class Magistrate/Tehsildar concerned
parsed.source_sentence: The Income Certificate should be issued by 1st Class Magistrate/Tehsildar concerned.
